title: H1: run rows carry attempt, decision kind and key, client version, policy version and route reason; tokens per accepted goal is undefined at zero accepted; by_goal shows median and max per goal with counts
spec:
Build on goal/T-0353 (Phase G code). Handover sections 2 (accounting). Evidence: bus.py:232-245 log_run has task, goal_id, role, tier, account, provider, outcome and token buckets but no attempt, decision kind/key, client version, policy version or route reason; scorecard.py:598-603 returns 0 tokens per accepted goal when no goal is accepted; by_goal/by_task return sums only.
1. bus.log_run accepts optional fields attempt (int, default 1), decision_kind, payload_key, route, route_reason, client_version, policy_version and writes them when given; callers that know them pass them (executor.start: attempt = rounds+1; spawn.run_worker: client_version from a cached `claude --version` read once per process, never per call, falling back to None; planner_runs launch site: decision_kind and payload_key). policy_version = bus.policy_version(): sha256 over the bytes of .orchestrator/pool.toml plus every .orchestrator/prompts/*.md in sorted order, first 12 hex chars, computed once per process and re-read only when any mtime changed. Unknown values stay None, never an empty string or 0.
2. scorecard.tokens_per_accepted_goal returns None for the per-accepted ratio when accepted count is 0 (keep totals); cli prints "undefined (0 accepted goals)" in that cell; JSON output emits null.
3. scorecard.by_goal adds per goal: n_tasks, tokens_median_per_task, tokens_max_per_task; when n_tasks under 5 the text renderer prints "n=<count> range <min>-<max>" instead of a median. Legacy rows without normalised buckets count with their total_tokens as before.
4. Document the new fields in README (run row schema paragraph) in one short list.
Tests: tests/test_bus.py::test_log_run_carries_decision_identity_and_versions (fields written when given, absent when None), ::test_policy_version_stable_until_prompt_or_pool_changes; tests/test_scorecard.py::test_tokens_per_accepted_goal_undefined_at_zero, ::test_by_goal_median_and_range_small_sample. Keep every existing test green; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0; git add -A and commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: orchestrator scorecard --by goal on a state with zero accepted goals prints undefined, never 0, for the per-accepted ratio
README lists the new run-row fields
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
